title: The Dream That Started it All
content: As a kid, age 7-10. I had months on and off where I had a reoccurring dream where a huge, tall black wolf with glowing red eyes would be chasing me. No matter where I was at in my dreams it always was able to get me and just before it landed it's decisive attack lunge, I would wake up in a cold sweat. Dream 1) In my home at the time, at night and it would be circling our house and just as I was able to find a hiding spot it would jump through the window and get me. Dream 2 ) Riding in a vehicle in the middle of a long stretch of highway in the middle of a expansive desert only to realize it was running alongside the vehicle. It would vanish and just as I felt safe, the floorboard beneath my feet would be torn away and I would be pulled through the floor. It was like it was made of smoke but somehow still solid. It never made noise but somehow you could sense it's vibrations and or energy and it screamed danger. Who else had this dream as kid or has had it since as an adult. Was this our introduction to the Mall World? Like some kind of test to see what we could handle.
